newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli killed in mystery explosion at kibbutz.
newsitem.headline: Israeli killed in mystery explosion at kibbutz.

text.p: An Israeli was killed on Sunday by an explosion, apparently of a hand grenade, on a collective farm in the Jewish state's northern Galilee region, police and witnesses said.

Large numbers of police closed off the area of Kibbutz Sde Nehemia and investigators sought to determine the cause of the blast, which killed kibbutz treasurer Gabi Metzer, 50, as he mounted a bicycle beside the collective's garage.

"From the houses about 200 metres (yards) away, we heard a huge explosion," kibbutz member Haim Shafir told reporters. "We saw the fellow lying on the ground, bleeding all over, from the legs, chest, and head." Metzer died en route to hospital.
Local police commander Mark Siluk said that "the signs at the scene indicate that the explosion was caused by a grenade" but the facts were still under investigation.
